objectives.description: Build matrix mechanically from manifests (140 standard + 17 hard pairs), not hardcoded
Assert 1: skill resolution matches manifest declarations, plus --hard on general/meta/markdown
Assert 2: agent existence for every routing_agents/routing_agents_hard declaration
Assert 3: engine parity, structural (grep both SKILL.md for command-route-agent.sh, absence of case-table/sed) plus semantic (hard fall-through never reuses standard block)
Assert 4: precedence direction via synthetic core+non-core conflicting fixture

approaches_tried.approach: Assert 1 negative control via mutating a manifest's routing.research.nix value
approaches_tried.reason: Assert 1's expected value is read from the same manifest data the resolver reads (by design, so the matrix auto-covers new extensions), so mutating manifest data moves both sides of the comparison together and the test trivially still passes. Documented inline in the test file; the meaningful negative control for Assert 1 is corrupting command-route-skill.sh's own resolution call, which was verified manually (141 induced failures) and reverted.
